'''Ben Robinson''' won the [[1997 Winnipeg Open]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"Age, 23. I was born and raised in Southern California and earned a Bachelors Degree in Chemistry from Southern California College. I am currently employed as a computer programmer while pursuing a career in the development of new software for computational chemistry. My hobbies include RC Helicopters, strategy games (all kinds) and multi-player computer games. Star Wars: Special Edition is my favorite movie. I currently enjoy watching the weekly episodes of the X-Files, as well as Star Trek DS9 and Voyager."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/robinson.html Ben Robinson], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428074607/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/robinson.html Internet Archive]</ref>
